customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

offerImport.title: Import product list
offerImport.description: Upload your product list. Products the catalogue already has become your offers straight away; the rest are proposed to the catalogue and reviewed before buyers see them.
offerImport.loadError: Could not load the import settings.
offerImport.notAllowed: Only the shop's owner or a manager can import product lists.

upload.fileHint: Comma, semicolon or tab separated, with a header row. Up to 500 rows. Your column mapping is remembered for next time.

mapping.minimum: A new product needs a barcode or a title, and a selling price; one you already sell needs only its barcode or SKU. Cost price and stock are optional; your cost is visible only to owners and managers.

preview.explain: Rows with errors are skipped. A product you already sell (found by barcode or SKU) has its price, cost and stock updated from the row; blank cells leave them as they are. A barcode the catalogue knows becomes your offer at once. Other rows are proposed as new products: they are completed from product databases and reviewed before buyers see them, already carrying your offer.

results.review: Proposed products are reviewed by the marketplace. Buyers see your offer on them once they are approved.

offerCost.title: Cost price
offerCost.warning: Selling at {{price}} loses money on every sale.
offerCost.private: Only owners and managers see this.

offerAuthors.title: Added by
offerAuthors.review: Added by scanning in the vendor app. Check its price and stock.

productCompleteness.title: Completeness
productCompleteness.missingIntro: Add these before the product can be published:
productCompleteness.pendingNote: Includes the changes you've submitted for review.

shopSetup.title: Shop setup
shopSetup.description: Buyers see your offers once couriers can collect from you, Oja can pay you, and you have set your opening hours.
shopSetup.loadError: Could not load your shop setup.
shopSetup.askAnOwner: Ask a shop owner or manager to enter the pickup address, bank account and opening hours.

status.pending_approval: Oja is reviewing your shop. It goes live once approved and every step below is done.
status.suspended: Your shop is suspended. Contact Oja to reopen it.
status.other: Your shop isn't open. Contact Oja.

pickup.description: Where couriers collect your orders. Find it, check the details, then place the pin where couriers should come. We check it with our delivery partner when you save.
pickup.validated: Couriers can find this address. Changing it checks it again.
pickup.noCountry: We can't tell which country your shop is in. Contact Oja.
pickup.noMatches: No matches. Try the street name and area, or enter it by hand.
pickup.enterManually: Can't find it? Enter it by hand
pickup.locationOff: Your browser didn't share your location. Search for the address, or allow location for this site.
pickup.nothingHere: We couldn't find an address where you are. Fill it in below, then check the pin.
pickup.pinPlaced: Pickup pin placed on the map.
pickup.pinToPlace: You'll place a pin on the map before saving.

pin.title: Where do couriers collect from you?
pin.help: Drag the pin, or click the map, to the shop's entrance. Couriers go to the pin.
pin.unavailable: The map isn't available right now, so the pin can't be placed. Try again later or contact Oja.

bank.description: Where your payouts go. We check the account with your bank when you save.

banner.missing: Buyers can't see your offers yet. Still to do: {{items}}.
banner.waiting: Buyers can't see your offers until Oja approves your shop.

shopHours.title: Opening hours
shopHours.description: When your shop is open. Buyers can order any time; outside your hours they are told the order is prepared when you open, and the 24 hours you have to accept an order count only while you are open.
shopHours.loadError: Could not load your opening hours.
shopHours.notSet: Set your weekly hours: buyers can't see your offers until you do.
shopHours.paused: Orders are paused until you resume them in the vendor app.
shopHours.pausedUntil: Orders are paused until {{until}}. Resume them in the vendor app.
shopHours.askAnOwner: Ask a shop owner or manager to change the opening hours.

weekly.title: Weekly hours
weekly.description: In your region's time ({{timeZone}}). A closing time of 00:00 means open until midnight.

exceptions.title: Closures and special hours
exceptions.description: Holidays, stocktakes, or opening on a day you are normally closed. While closed, buyers see when you reopen and your note, and can't order.
exceptions.none: No closures or special hours planned.
